slides.title: Every analysis, traceable
slides.text: qTrace records how you analyse images in QuPath, in the background. Each result can then be traced, replayed on new images and signed with your certified identity.

slides.title: Checking your connection
slides.text: qTrace downloads its modules from GitHub and your certificate from qtrace.ca. If your institution uses a proxy or a firewall, your IT team may need to allow both.

slides.title: Sign in to qtrace.ca
slides.text: Your browser opens qtrace.ca to create your account or sign in, and QuPath is connected on its own. No file to handle. If you received an invitation code by email, enter it: your account then gets the identity certificate that certifies the records you sign.

slides.title: Finish in your browser
slides.text: qtrace.ca opened in your browser: create your account or sign in, follow the steps shown there, then click “Authorize QuPath”. QuPath is connected as soon as you do.

account.title: You are signed in
account.text: You can upload, share and replay your records right away. They are not certified: an identity certificate, obtained from qtrace.ca, is what certifies the records you sign.

slides.title: Installing Compliance and your welcome
slides.text: Your certificate is saved. qTrace downloads the modules it gives you, then asks you to restart QuPath once.

account.title: Installing your modules
account.text: Records you upload are not certified. qTrace downloads the modules your account includes, then asks you to restart QuPath once.

slides.title: qTrace is on board
slides.text: qTrace already records your work in QuPath: open a project and work as usual. Whenever you want your results signed with your certified identity, sign in from Extensions > QTrace > Getting started.
